# Application Directory uses the saved root document directory

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

In Studio, a saved root FROG without a loaded project uses its containing directory as the application directory. The runner computes this exact expected path independently from the actual saved example file; it must not substitute the Studio installation or current working directory.

## What this example demonstrates

In Studio, a saved root FROG without a loaded project uses its containing directory as the application directory. The runner computes this exact expected path independently from the actual saved example file; it must not substitute the Studio installation or current working directory.
